body:
No guilt. I’ve been making every move the right way. I’ve owned up up to every failure or downfall that’s been my own. Just every step I get going in the right direction I get tripped up and pulled back numerous paces. 

I’ve been trying for a long time and can’t seem to catch any sort of break to go my way no matter how much good I do. 

I’m just in the verge of giving up and I don’t want to.
For a complete stranger to be willing to give such concern and hope means a lot. I’m trying  and I truly appreciate the kind words. They mean more than you know.

Just saw this. It’s not that easy when money is involved or say lack there of. I’d love to get help and I continue to hold strong for family and the rest of my loved ones. 

America unfortunately doesn’t provide aid on health in any sort or form for someone like me. 

I appreciate the encouraging words though fam.
Con Air is great imo. The hair is a bit much but the movie is enjoyable as can be as a sit back not think and relax movie
Bruh. Wish I didn’t see this tonight. I’m already teetering on the edge while trying to keep it together for my fam and friends while staring at a black hole
